ITR Refunds May Face Delays Due to New CBDT Strictness

Taxpayers who filed their Income Tax Returns (ITR) by the July 31 deadline may experience delays in receiving their refunds. The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has reportedly implemented new strict measures, which could impact the processing of these refunds. Specific details regarding the nature of these new strictures or the exact timeline for potential delays were not provided in the coverage.
